column1: # AUTO-GENERATED by tools/extract_questline_conditions.py --dag-corpus -- DO NOT EDIT, re-emit.
# One row per (AWARD SITE, cone ROOT) from the #1085 questline-condition extractor; parameterised-event call sites are complete.
# The artifacts it reads (decompiled EMEVD + talk ESD) are licensing-restricted and absent from CI,
#   so this table is COMMITTED and re-emitted by hand -- the same shape as greenfield/flag_names.tsv.
# 🛑 A ROW IS A COND ROOT, NOT A VERDICT. cone_completeness says how much of the cone was read:
#   complete = nothing refused; budget_capped = only CAPS were hit (the cone can MISS a prerequisite,
#   never invent one); unreadable = a guard could not be read at all. build_questline_dag.py owns
#   the admission rule and tallies what it refuses.
# 🛑 disjunctive=Y: the SITE guards contain an `||` and the arms were UNIONED, so those roots are an
#   OVER-approximation. A disjunction met further down a setter chain is not marked at all, which is
#   why no consumer may read a site's roots as a proven conjunction.
# 🛑 ObjAct / MSB / ChrActivateConditionParam / ceremony / shop-lineup gating is OUTSIDE this corpus.
#   Absence of a row is 'no gate visible here', never 'no gate'.
# MEASURED THIS EMIT: 8996 row(s) | cone: budget_capped 3435, complete 1184, unreadable 4377
